contact.subject: commercial desk and product communication context
contact.rightsNote: Pexels free stock source; retain source record. Photography is intentionally secondary to contact routing and the enquiry CTA.

companyProfile.rightsNote: No stock photography and no fabricated PDF cover. Current Hero explicitly shows a branded pending state until the approved PDF/preview exists.
companyProfile.businessReason: The page is a document resource destination, so the real document state is the visual subject.

faq.rightsNote: No stock photography. Uses controlled brand surfaces and semantic icons only.
faq.businessReason: Four topic cues are more useful than decorative photography on a support/clarification page.

privacy.rightsNote: No stock photography. Uses brand assets and shield/file/user semantic icons; no biometric or cybersecurity claims are implied.
privacy.businessReason: The Hero explains data handling/trust without legal or cyber-security stock clichés.

terms.rightsNote: No stock photography. Uses a controlled 01–10 clause index and document semantics only.
terms.businessReason: Prepares the user for structured legal reading without courtroom, gavel or contract-signing imagery.
